baikonur-cosmodrome-museum.name: Baikonur Cosmodrome Museum (city House of Culture; related site-2 museum)

rows.item: Soyuz T-10 descent module (return craft of the Soyuz T-11 Indo-Soviet crew incl. Rakesh Sharma), shown with Sharma's space suit
rows.notes: Evidence is a Commons photo taken 22 Jul 2012 (category 'Soyuz T-10 at Nehru Planetarium'), the Wikipedia article Soyuz T-10, and an undated school-trip article https://theindianschool.in/school-news/sky-walk-a-trip-to-the-nehru-planetarium ('A major attraction was the Soyuz T-10 which carried Indias first cosmonaut'). The planetarium's own site (nehruplanetarium.org) does not mention it, so current display is not confirmed.

rows.item: Piece of window glass from Buran OK-1K1 (the flown orbiter, destroyed in the 2002 hangar collapse)
rows.notes: Commons photo dated 13 Apr 2026 by Nikolai Bulykin; description names OK-1K1 and the Baikonur Cosmodrome museum in the city House of Culture. Single photo source; no museum web page found.
